description: President Masoud Pezeshkian says Tehran is ready to restore the June ceasefire if Washington returns to its commitments, as Iran works with Oman on Strait of Hormuz shipping and holds talks with Russia and China

title: UK readies ‘comprehensive’ sanctions on West Bank settlements as Sa’ar warns of retaliation
description: Ed Miliband says Britain is examining trade, financing and advertising tied to settlements, while Gideon Sa’ar warns any action against Israel will trigger a response

title: Yair Golan threatens NIS 2.5M suit over Sara Netanyahu Oct. 7 conspiracy claims
description: Democrats chairman gives Sara Netanyahu 24 hours to apologize and demands compensation be donated to Nova survivors

title: Hamas’ Gaza City internal security chief captured in special operation
description: Israel says Muin al-Arabid, a senior figure in Hamas’ counterintelligence apparatus, was seized by a local militia in an hours-long operation backed by IDF airstrikes

title: 12 Israeli prison officers charged in death of Palestinian inmate, assaulting 8 others
description: Prosecutors say a shift commander ordered guards into the cell after the prisoner asked whether there was a ceasefire; officers allegedly beat inmates with fists, kicks and batons, then failed to report the incident and later tried to coordinate accounts

title: Yair Golan threatens lawsuit after Sara Netanyahu suggests he knew of October 7 attack
description: The Democratic Party chairman prepares a defamation warning against Sara Netanyahu and Channel 14 after she suggested he knew of the Hamas attack in advance; AFP says the allegations echo recurring conspiracy theories

title: Palestinians report Israeli special forces in Gaza City amid intense strikes and clashes
description: Palestinians report 4 killed in more than 18 airstrikes as special forces enter western Gaza City; Al-Hadath links the fighting to a failed abduction attempt by an Israel-linked militia

title: Captain arrested after northern Cyprus ferry disaster leaves 8 dead, 20 missing
description: Filo Jet lies more than 500 meters underwater as crews search for passengers feared trapped inside; survivors allege too few life jackets and a mother recounts losing two children

title: ‘This is what we’re fighting for’: Golani commanders take children to first grade
description: Ahead of Sept. 1, Golani made an unusual decision: commanders can take their children to school; 'Ella knows Dad fights the bad guys and is very proud,' says Lt. Col. A., commander of Battalion 12

title: Vance defends ties to influencers accused of amplifying antisemitism
description: Vice president tells Jewish conservatives the US-Israel relationship should be rooted in a ‘concrete alignment of interest,’ while defending engagement with influential podcasters and drawing a line at Nick Fuentes

title: Israel’s 2.6 million students return to school as displaced communities come home
description: Some 180,000 children begin first grade as schools reopen in communities evacuated after Oct. 7 and northern border towns welcome students back after years of displacement

title: Ultra-Orthodox protesters vandalize secular Jerusalem school ahead of opening day
description: Police deploy to secular school in Kiryat Yovel after protesters scrawl anti-'immodesty' messages, dump garbage and post anti-draft stickers amid wider tensions over Jerusalem’s religious character

title: Back to school, but not back to normal: Kiryat Shmona faces a battle for its students
description: Northern city and Upper Galilee communities begin the school year with fewer students, undersized classes and the scars of war still visible, as officials struggle to bring back families who remained in central Israel

title: ‘Love-boat diplomacy’: Trump envoy’s $450M megayacht tour angers Italians
description: Tilman Fertitta says the $1 million-a-day voyage is a diplomatic tour, but lavish parties and Italian-funded security have fueled protests and criticism over wealth, privilege and the blurred line between private luxury and public service

title: IDF bars female reservists from operational driving course despite wartime service
description: Women who met the course requirements were dropped days before training under a ‘men only’ rule, even after female combat soldiers had completed the program and served operationally during the war

title: Ra’am makes history with first Jewish candidate as Segalovitz joins Mansour Abbas
description: Former Yesh Atid lawmaker is expected to take Ra’am’s No. 2 slot, while retaining independent votes on religion, security and LGBTQ rights and joining Mansour Abbas in a renewed push against crime in Arab society

title: Vance acknowledges US ammunition shortage as Iran campaign strains military
description: Vice president blames years of underinvestment under Biden as Pentagon warnings mount that prolonged Middle East operations could weaken US defenses elsewhere

title: Dado Bar Kalifa named next IDF Central Command chief
description: Bar Kalifa will replace Avi Bluth in 2027, weeks after Defense Minister Israel Katz announced the move on live TV without coordinating with Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir

title: 'This is ethnic cleansing': ex-IDF generals warn settler violence is becoming a threat to Israel itself
description: The New York Times highlights a growing group of former security chiefs and officials who say attacks on Palestinians, land seizures and weak enforcement are displacing communities, damaging Israel abroad and eroding its democratic character

title: Tel Aviv curbs water use as most Israeli desalination plants remain shut
description: Sorek A has resumed operations, but most private plants remain affected by severe sea turbidity; authorities order public irrigation halted while southern agriculture faces freshwater cuts

title: Second Israeli missing in Nepal-Tibet floods as thousands remain unaccounted for
description: Foreign Ministry says Katerina Zakovic, 41, who also holds Belarusian citizenship, is missing; another Israeli traveler remains unaccounted for as the regional death toll rises to 919

title: ‘You’re not taking me from my daughter’: mom loses hand fighting great white shark
description: Leah Stewart, 34, was attacked about 30 meters off Sydney’s Coogee Beach, suffered severe injuries to her other arm and leg, spent more than a week in a coma and is now undergoing rehabilitation after returning to walking

title: IDF plans sweeping crackdown on West Bank extremists with outpost evacuations, arrests
description: Security officials say a hard core of 70–100 activists is driving the violence, with incursions into Palestinian villages raising fears of a wider West Bank escalation and prompting sharper enforcement by police, Shin Bet and the IDF

title: ‘I planted a bomb near Netanyahu’s home’: man charged after night of threatening calls to police
description: Mahmoud Abd al-Majid, 28, from Ilut allegedly threatened attacks on Jews, Arabs and officers, claimed he was armed with an M-16 and handgun, warned of a bomb at a Haifa police station and later assaulted two passengers before his arrest
